0.content:
Varesa is Iansan's "star student, my pride and joy". Iansan noticed her when Varesa knocked a hilichurl's club flying and it struck Iansan on the head. She took over Varesa's training, gave her father a meal plan, then rewrote it once she understood Varesa's extraordinary metabolism, and got her into the tribe's Patrol Team, where Iansan usually gives her orders. Iansan says Varesa can lift more than she can and only lacks confidence. She worries that Varesa is too relaxed and eats too much sugar; Varesa sneaks snacks at a secret campsite.

Iansan once put Varesa on an intensive swimming programme at the People of the Springs to burn fat, while Mualani towed Iansan around in a life preserver to watch. In the Abyss war's final counterattack, Iansan, the backbone of the tribe's defence, fought to clear a path and turned to find only Varesa still with her. Varesa handed her a wounded older warrior, charged the enemy leader and was later dug out of the battlefield by Iansan, asleep, her Vision crackling with Electro. During the 5.1 battle, when Mualani worried about the distant Collective of Plenty, Iansan said Varesa had reported the tribe safe.

1.content:
Iansan does not like leaning on anyone, but she says following Mavuika feels natural, "like moving towards the light when you're surrounded by darkness", because she trusts her as a close friend. Early in her Pilgrimage career, rivals ganged up on her. Mavuika advised her to prove her strength beyond doubt, and Iansan did so by challenging Mavuika herself in the arena; she fought well enough that no one underestimated her again. Mavuika also advised her to charge for classes.

In 5.0 Iansan was in the Speaker's Chamber when Mavuika admitted the Contending Fire was running out and secretly poured her own power into the Sacred Flame. Iansan protested that the sacrifice was "not right". She later apologised when Mavuika burned her people's keepsakes to open the way out of the Night Kingdom. In 5.3 she designed the course for Mavuika's new Pilgrimage and ran a trial with her.

2.content:
Emela was an orphaned baby Tatankasaurus raised by the Collective of Plenty. She became Iansan's sparring partner when Iansan couldn't budge an adult saurian. Their first duel ended with both collapsing and no winner, and they stayed rivals for life, each racing to surpass the other. Emela grew larger than any Tatankasaurus in the tribe and became chief of the Tatankasaurs, but still let Iansan ride on her back to explore the wilds.

Emela died in the war against the Abyss invasion, charging a great many enemies while Iansan was away. Iansan's students blamed themselves; Iansan told them that if she had been there, she would have charged at Emela's side. Laying a flower on the grave, she first spoke their rivalry's unspoken rule: "Only by taking the lead can you protect the ones you've left behind."

3.content: The patterned Tatankasaurus skull Iansan carries is Alaye. Emela found the spirit of a young Tatankasaurus that would not move on to the Night Kingdom. Iansan asked Citlali to bind it into its own skull, much as a Tzitzimitl is made, so it would neither lose its way nor fade. Alaye is shy and grunts encouragement during workouts when it thinks no one is around. Iansan believes it stayed because it wanted to grow up strong.

4.comment: Iansan: Uwezo and the Blood of Egungun
4.content:
Uwezo ("Power") is a highly honoured Ancient Name in the Collective of Plenty. When it chose Iansan, a girl of the child-sized Egungun bloodline, much of the tribe thought her unworthy. Her family had always kept their heads down as medics and cooks. Iansan sees her training as her personal footnote to the name: "You need not be born with power. Toil is what truly imparts strength." The Pilgrim's Chronicle describes Uwezo's hand as one "extended to all who are lonely and sorrowful".

Uwezo once belonged to the ancient Electro hero Wanjiru. During the 5.1 ritual that created the Ode of Resurrection, Iansan's line, spoken with Wanjiru, was "Knowing true power". Rumours that the Egungun blood trades height for strength are outsiders' inventions; Iansan denies them.

5.comment: Iansan: The Founder's Barbell and Iansan's Vision
5.content: The fitness club was founded by Meztcala, a mighty chief who taught his people his methods during a volcanic eruption cycle so that they could protect themselves. A legendary barbell at the centre of the grounds was said to be liftable only by someone at the peak of strength. When Iansan said it would take "the Power of a Thousand Days", people assumed it was a fad. She trained unnoticed in a corner, moving gradually onto standard equipment and defeating the Tatankasaur chief along the way. On the thousandth day the whole tribe gathered. She found a Vision hanging from the bar, took it off and lifted the barbell as calmly as any item on her plan.

6.content:
Iansan's training academy is open to any tribe, age or gender. She moved the fitness club close to the Stadium of the Sacred Flame to host it. Newcomers, disappointed by the "world-renowned coach", are invited to pick any exercise and compete against her; after they collapse, she adds ten to twenty more sets with their weights. She designs custom equipment so that people intimidated by free weights can still train.

The first, free classes got her reported as a scammer; after Mavuika suggested a fee, demand soared. Students who stayed a year became top Pilgrimage competitors. Famous absentees include Mualani and Ifa. Her gym's reputation has spread: a Collective of Plenty wrestler in a limited-time event recommends a ten-year membership as a sure way to get stronger.

7.comment: Iansan: Kachina and the Night Kingdom Rescue
7.content:
Kachina came to Iansan's classes for years, often leaving defeated and apologising. Iansan waived her fees, felt she had failed her, and let her train any time. Both won the 5.0 Pilgrimage, and Iansan told Kachina it was an honour to fight beside her.

Kachina fell in the Night Warden War, and the Ode of Resurrection failed because the Abyss had corrupted the Wayob. Iansan volunteered to go into the Night Kingdom with Mualani, Chasca and the Traveler, and told Mavuika there would be no situation she couldn't handle. They found Kachina and saved a Wayob totem. Mavuika's projection saved them as time ran out. Iansan learned that Mualani was also part of the five-hundred-year plan.

8.comment: Iansan: The Ode of Resurrection and the Abyss War
8.content: In 5.1 Iansan was one of the six modern Ancient Name heroes, with Mualani, Kinich, Xilonen, Ororon and Chasca, who called forth past heroes so Mavuika could create the Ode of Resurrection. Afterwards she fought the Abyss outside the Stadium. Her own tribe, farthest from the Abyss's entry point, was largely spared, with help from Varesa and Chasca. When victory came in 5.3 she scrambled off to find a Kamera to record it, and invited the Traveler (and Paimon, whose nutrition plan was "already set") to visit the Collective of Plenty.

9.comment: Iansan: Relief at the Flower-Feather Clan
9.content: After the war (5.2 interlude), Iansan brought her students and a merchant caravan to help the Flower-Feather Clan rebuild. With Chief Mutota and the Traveler she treated warriors hallucinating from Abyssal Corrosion Syndrome. She concluded that the key to reaching each one was whatever they cherished most, then helped the frightened Cochitta win back her courage by defeating riftwolves. When Ocotlan attacked his own father, she and the Traveler subdued him, and The Captain arrived with a Draught of Lucidity, which Iansan gave to Ocotlan to cure him. She told the Traveler that true strength is really problem-solving: break the task into small steps and act.

10.content: After peace returned, Mavuika put Iansan in charge of designing the course for the new Pilgrimage, a contest for sport rather than for choosing warriors. Iansan built a kindling-chasing obstacle course using the whole Stadium, ran Mavuika and the Traveler through a trial (an old device woke up and spawned enemies she hadn't planned) and added a ball launcher, with Xilonen's help. As the course designer she did not compete. Instead she made every contestant warm up, including the returning first Pyro Archon, Xbalanque, whom she told to do twice as many warm-ups.

key: A Space and Time for You
11.comment: Iansan: The Abyss Order's Attack (A Space and Time for You)
11.content: In 5.7 Iansan asked the Traveler to help patrol the Collective's territory during a bodybuilding contest. On patrol they found the key to their sibling's hibernation chamber. The Abyss Order then struck every tribe at once. Iansan escorted the Traveler to Mavuika, fought beside Citlali at the Masters of the Night-Wind, and found it odd that the Order held back. She later reported that the Order's front line had collapsed before a lone, vengeful fighter (Dainsleif) and passed on news that the Scions had found the Order's base at Ochkanatlan.

12.comment: Iansan: Tournament of Glory in Bloom
12.content: During the 5.5 limited-time event Tournament of Glory in Bloom, the six tribes revived the long-forgotten Bloomflower Trials, a contest between the tribes. Iansan recruited for the Collective of Plenty, offering the Traveler a year of training sessions and a personalised nutrition plan to join, and later fought in the Traveler's party. She gathered Ocean Zephyrs with the saurians and confessed she was "really bad at acting". She also washed sawdust from Varesa's eyes after Varesa skipped her goggles.

13.content: Xilonen was Iansan's first friend from the Children of Echoes and one of the few people who can build her equipment designs well. Iansan's only complaint is that Xilonen pushes back her deadlines. Xilonen remembers Iansan inspecting a whole order of super-heavy plates and dumbbells and barely getting winded. Xilonen made her compact, dense barbell, and never lets her use the forge herself.

14.content: Iansan respects "Granny Itztli" but not her habits: she once thought Citlali was an early riser, until she realised Citlali was only going home after staying up all night. When Citlali's age became a topic, the resourceful Iansan asked Mavuika to check the Sacred Flame's memories; even they gave no answer. Citlali, for her part, half-jokes that anyone that strong must have a power-up that makes her seven feet tall. Iansan learned meditation from the Masters of the Night-Wind.
